meta.title: POSMTRADE — POS materials and cardboard displays
meta.description: POSMTRADE designs and manufactures cardboard displays, stands and POS materials for retail: from engineering and 3D mock-up to printing, assembly and delivery.

hero.title: Make your product stand out on the shelf
hero.lead: We design and manufacture cardboard displays, stands and POS materials for retail — from the first idea and 3D mock-up to printing, assembly and delivery to the store.

stats.label: the year our project records start
digital assistants handle mail and documents

services.title: Everything that helps sell at the point of sale
services.intro: Every piece is engineered for a specific product, shelf and store — sturdy, quick to assemble and good-looking.

items.title: Floor displays
items.text: Stands with shelves, side panels and a topper: they carry the product and assemble without tools.

items.title: Counter displays
items.text: Compact displays for the checkout and counter — the product within reach at the moment of decision.

items.title: Toppers and branding
items.text: Shaped toppers, side panels and bases in full-colour print, visible from across the store.

items.title: Shelf strips
items.text: Price strips, shelf stickers and promo elements that make the brand stand out in the aisle.

items.title: Labels and marking
items.text: Stickers, marking and labels for batches and promotions — exactly to artwork and quantity.

items.title: Shipping packaging
items.text: Boxes that get the display safely to the store and make set-up quick on site.

process.title: From brief to store — one partner

steps.title: Brief
steps.text: Product, dimensions, quantity, store and deadline — we clarify everything that shapes the design.

steps.title: Engineering
steps.text: Our engineer designs the die-line: parts, shelves, locks and load.

steps.title: 3D mock-up
steps.text: We show how the assembled piece will look before anything is printed.

steps.title: Print and die-cut
steps.text: Full-colour print, lamination and die-cutting to the approved artwork.

steps.title: Assembly and packing
steps.text: We check a sample and pack it in shipping boxes with instructions.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.text: We ship the batch and the paperwork — no extra e-mails or manual routine.

mockup.title: See the display before it is printed
mockup.text: From the drawing and artwork we build a 3D model of the display: sides, shelves, topper and print in place. Approval is faster and mistakes show up before production.

agents.title: Digital assistants working alongside the team
agents.intro: POSMTRADE helps authorized organizations automate the processing of corporate e-mail and documents. Digital assistants sort messages and prepare reports, labels and calculations — only within the access the company has approved.

items.name: Пані Галочка
items.text: Checks logistics e-mails and asks for whatever is missing.

items.name: Звітник
items.text: Builds reports and delivery notes and sends a reminder when something is missing.

items.name: Наліпка
items.text: Prepares labels and marking from an Excel sheet.

items.name: Форматинка
items.text: Turns invoices and statements from PDF into clear Excel tables.

items.name: Мірка
items.text: Converts square metres to running metres and back in seconds.

items.name: Крамар
items.text: Turns a supplier document into a material purchase in the warehouse system.

items.name: Візуальчик
items.text: Finds past projects from a photo or a description.

items.name: Макетчик
items.text: Builds a 3D mock-up of a display from the drawing and artwork.

items.name: Договірник
items.text: Checks that the customer has a valid contract.

items.name: Вчасник
items.text: Keeps track of electronic documents and their signatures.

agents.principlesTitle: Less routine. More time for decisions.

points.title: Secure operation
points.text: Information is used only to provide the service and only within the approved scope.

points.title: Limited access
points.text: The service works only with authorized corporate access.

points.title: Human control
points.text: Unclear cases go to a person. The final decision stays with an authorized employee.

agents.dataNote: Data is not used for advertising and is never sold.

contact.title: Got a product that needs a stage?
contact.text: Tell us about the product and the store — we will propose a design, show a 3D mock-up and quote the batch.

footer.tagline: POS materials, displays and automation for retail.
